info.name: SWD392 - Waste Collection API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for SWD392 Waste Collection System.

Roles: ADMIN, ENTERPRISE, COLLECTOR, CITIZEN

**Setup:**
1. Set variable `baseUrl` = `http://localhost:8080/api`
2. Run **[AUTH] Admin Setup** first to get admin token
3. Run requests in order for full business flow test

Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables via Tests scripts.
